{{Top|leg}}
'''Girder mold''' was a kind of [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Mold/Legends|mold]] that grew within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Cog Hive Seven]]. If mixed with [[Blood/Legends|blood]], it became corrosive enough to eat through [[Steel/Legends|steel]]. While undercover as "Jagannath," the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] used a handful of girder mold to incapacitate the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Rook]] by grinding the mold into an open wound on the latter's scalp.<ref name="Maul Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>
